newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian govt July core deficit A$3.547 bln.
newsitem.headline: Australian govt July core deficit A$3.547 bln.

text.p: The Australian government's underlying budget deficit for July, the first month of the fiscal year, was A$3.547 billion, up from A$1.295 billion in July 1995, Finance Minister John Fahey said.
The headline deficit, including asset sales and the like, was A$3.249 billion for the month, compared with a A$450 million surplus a year before.
Government finances are highly seasonal and the data cannot be extrapolated to produce a full year estimate.
The underlying budget deficit for the fiscal year to June was A$10.330 billion, down from A$13.211 billion a year before.
The government's August 20 budget projects a 1996/97 deficit of A$5.649 billion.
